label: Claude Sonnet 5.5
output:
To: #team-selection
Replying to: s01
Cc: none
Subject: none

Dear Marek,

Thank you for posting the lineup. I would like to raise one point about Liliana Bąk, and I hope we can settle it before the names go to the organisers on Friday.

On 1 October you wrote that selection would be based on the November FIDE list and on form in club events, and that the coaches of the players would be consulted before the final lineup. I was not consulted, and I think some context would have changed the picture.

For health reasons, Liliana missed about two weeks of training in October, and she was not well during the Katowice open, where she still played all her games. The -81 on the November list comes from that tournament alone, so I do not think it reflects her real strength. Without it she would be at about 1932. She is now back to her normal level, and her last three lessons were very good.

The second criterion points the same way. In the rapid qualifier on 24 October Liliana finished second with 5.5/7, beating Maja and Antoni and drawing with Kacper, while Igor scored 4/7. Going by the rating list alone leaves out half of the criteria you set.

To be clear, I have nothing against Igor. He is a good player and a good kid, and he has had a steady autumn. My concern is only that we apply the agreed rule consistently.

I would therefore ask that Liliana be placed on board 2. If you prefer a more objective basis, I am also happy with a short match between Liliana and Igor before Friday, and the winner takes the place.

I would be glad to discuss this with you, Rafael and the other coaches, so that the decision is clear to everyone before the deadline.

Best regards,
Oksana
